name: startree-pinot
description: Query and inspect Apache Pinot and StarTree Cloud: explore tables, schemas and segments, run validated read-only SQL, and preview schema and table-config changes before applying them.

controller_url.title: Pinot controller URL
controller_url.description: Used for table, schema and segment metadata, for example http://localhost:9000 or your StarTree Cloud controller URL

broker_url.title: Pinot broker URL
broker_url.description: Used for SQL queries, for example http://localhost:8000 or your StarTree Cloud broker URL

token.title: Pinot or StarTree API token
token.description: Sent to your cluster as the Authorization header. Leave empty for a cluster without auth or when you use a username and password

username.title: Username
username.description: Basic auth username. Leave empty when you use a token or the cluster has no auth

password.title: Password
password.description: Basic auth password. Leave empty when you use a token or the cluster has no auth

database.title: Database
database.description: For clusters with several databases. Leave empty for the default database
